carts_exactly_one_owner_check.name: carts_exactly_one_owner_check
carts_exactly_one_owner_check.value: ("carts"."user_id" is not null) <> ("carts"."guest_token_hash" is not null)

orders_coupon_consistency_check.name: orders_coupon_consistency_check
orders_coupon_consistency_check.value:
("orders"."coupon_id" is null and "orders"."coupon_code_snapshot" is null and "orders"."coupon_discount_amount" = 0)
				or ("orders"."coupon_id" is not null and "orders"."coupon_code_snapshot" is not null)

orders_delivery_shape_check.name: orders_delivery_shape_check
orders_delivery_shape_check.value:
("orders"."delivery_method" is null
					and "orders"."pickup_location_id" is null and "orders"."delivery_zone_id" is null
					and "orders"."recipient_name" is null and "orders"."recipient_phone" is null
					and "orders"."delivery_city" is null and "orders"."delivery_street" is null and "orders"."delivery_house" is null)
				or ("orders"."delivery_method" = 'pickup'
					and "orders"."pickup_location_id" is not null and "orders"."delivery_zone_id" is null
					and "orders"."recipient_name" is null and "orders"."recipient_phone" is null
					and "orders"."delivery_city" is null and "orders"."delivery_street" is null and "orders"."delivery_house" is null)
				or ("orders"."delivery_method" = 'courier'
					and "orders"."pickup_location_id" is null and "orders"."delivery_zone_id" is not null
					and "orders"."recipient_name" is not null and "orders"."recipient_phone" is not null
					and "orders"."delivery_city" is not null and "orders"."delivery_street" is not null and "orders"."delivery_house" is not null)

payments_refund_status_consistency_check.name: payments_refund_status_consistency_check
payments_refund_status_consistency_check.value:
("payments"."status" = 'refunded' and "payments"."refunded_amount" = "payments"."amount")
				or ("payments"."status" = 'partially_refunded' and "payments"."refunded_amount" > 0 and "payments"."refunded_amount" < "payments"."amount")
				or ("payments"."status" not in ('refunded', 'partially_refunded') and "payments"."refunded_amount" = 0)

promotions_discount_value_check.name: promotions_discount_value_check
promotions_discount_value_check.value:
("promotions"."discount_type" = 'percentage' and "promotions"."percentage_value" between 1 and 100 and "promotions"."fixed_amount" is null)
				or ("promotions"."discount_type" = 'fixed_amount' and "promotions"."fixed_amount" > 0 and "promotions"."percentage_value" is null)

promotions_date_range_check.name: promotions_date_range_check
promotions_date_range_check.value: "promotions"."starts_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" is null or "promotions"."starts_at" <= "promotions"."ends_at"

coupons_discount_value_check.name: coupons_discount_value_check
coupons_discount_value_check.value:
("coupons"."discount_type" = 'percentage' and "coupons"."percentage_value" between 1 and 100 and "coupons"."fixed_amount" is null)
				or ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'fixed_amount' and "coupons"."fixed_amount" > 0 and "coupons"."percentage_value" is null)

coupons_date_range_check.name: coupons_date_range_check
coupons_date_range_check.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."starts_at" <= "coupons"."ends_at"
